reserveReview.rationale: The issuer live backing API read on 2026-10-27 (HTTP Date 08:46:51 GMT) reports 34,939.62211545444 USDU-equivalent in Morpho and 22,686.925540211709 in Curve, with 5.1206765e-10 in TermMax, totaling 57,626.54765566666. Ethereum block 26282914 (hash 0x748ac3086a5b99e61d6a72dffd1d57911554c9f144826ad8fc08c72a774cafe0, timestamp 2026-10-27T08:41:47Z) identifies Curve coins(0) as USDC and coins(1) as USDU; balances(0) and balances(1) return 9,929.076831 USDC and 40,176.239362205237 USDU. Splitting the API-valued Curve position by those constituent balances and normalizing total backing yields 60.6311% Morpho self-exposure, 31.5674% Curve USDU self-exposure, and 7.8015% external USDC collateral after rounding the residual. The Curve pool is now USDU-heavy relative to 2026-09-21, which shifts the self-exposure share. The issuer API does not expose its own block number and was read about five minutes after the pinned block; these are same-day observations rather than a claimed atomic reconciliation. No circulating-supply value is overridden.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer live backing API observed 2026-10-27T08:46:51Z, with Curve LP constituents read on Ethereum at block 26282914
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The dated 2026-10-27 composition covers the disclosed Morpho USDU, Curve LP and TermMax positions. At Ethereum block 26098837 on 2026-10-01, two additional valid SwapBridgeMorphoV1 modules reported 2.470331 USDU-equivalent in a USDC vault and 1.003272 in a USDT vault. The re-fetched issuer backing API exposes total, morpho, curve and termmax aggregates without a module roster or accounting timestamp, so it does not directly establish whether these modules are included. A complete current denominator requires all active-module positions and historical-module residuals with consistently valued LP and vault exposures; the 2026-10-27 re-fetch of the issuer API still exposes only total, morpho, curve and termmax aggregates, so inclusion of those modules in the API total remains unestablished.
